# VCPUI source snapshot

Source: https://github.com/lioensky/VCPChat

Revision: `f6df1f175a09cec467e7d62d22f3173fb798db83`.

Copied with normalized line endings: `modules/ui-system/vcp-ui.js`, `modules/ui-system/component-manifest.js`, `styles/ui-system/tokens.css`, `styles/ui-system/components.css`, `styles/appearance.css`, and `LICENSE`. Source names are preserved except the directory structure.

`lucide-adapter.js` is `modules/ui-system/lucide-adapter.js` from revision `74d4a4919e953f8b85c9cec642500ea5ac99eed9`, copied unchanged with normalized line endings. The icons it renders come from `../lucide/`.

Copyright remains with the upstream contributors. License: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, included here.

The standalone page uses VCPUI's native control kernel, Button, SegmentedControl and form enhancers. No Web Awesome, chat runtime, private settings or artwork is bundled. Future embedded hosting must supply appearance and lifecycle integration; this snapshot does not claim VCPChat integration is complete.
